description: What the window is allowed to do. Filesystem access is scoped to the app's own data directory; anything outside it has to come from a dialog the user answered. Three permissions are here because no default set carries them: `start-dragging`, without which the title bar cannot move the window (the overlay title bar style draws the webview over the native band, so a drag travels through `data-tauri-drag-region`); `fs:watch`, so an edit made to the project file outside the app is noticed; `opener:open-path`, so that file can be opened in whatever the system uses for JSON; and `process:restart`, which is how an installed update finishes.
